description: An unknown left operand of && hides the error of a template with a tuple part before an unknown one
notes: The spec doesn't say that an unknown operand hides errors in the other one. The ShortCircuit function of OpLogicalAnd (hclsyntax/expression_ops.go) returns an unknown bool with only the left operand's errors when both operands are unknown and the left one has no errors. TemplateExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression_template.go) keeps evaluating parts after an interpolation that can't convert to a string, so the later unknown part makes the failed template's result unknown, and its error isn't reported.
